summary: This directory provides a centralized service for managing and retrieving application parameters. It enables the retrieval of typed configuration values that are sensitive to user-specific contexts and supports historical lookup of previous parameter states.
responsibilities: Retrieve configuration values based on user context
Support historical lookup of parameter changes
relationships: The ParameterService uses user context to determine which version of a parameter to retrieve.
Historical lookups allow the system to access past states of managed application parameters.
